name: Sandra Michaels
notes: Known from one roleplay posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy on 9 May 1999, titled "RP Critique", served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/rp-critique-1999-05-09.html: a member of the Gyeah Wrestling women's division who, in black leather shorts and a white silk shirt, leaves her partner Eric in their apartment and sits on a park bench to give a sickly reporter an interview about her rival Lindsey, who is trying to build a stable with Psycho Soup, and the strip match set up between them. The surname is the writer's own, from the subject line of the repost of the same roleplay ("[RP Critique] Sandra Michaels, Gyeah Women's Div.", message 5dxL06NEgnMJ, not served).
caption: A cold Gyeah women's division wrestler who mocks Lindsey's stable plans from a park bench in May 1999.

name: Art Zandelli
notes: Known from one post to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (27 October 1999), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/reading-material-nemesis-rp-gyeah-wrestling-1999-10-27.html: Nemesis of the Brotherhood, introduced as a two-time heavyweight champion, trades insults with sports-radio host Art Zandelli ahead of the April Anarchy card, taking on the Kindred and Damien King by name.
caption: The sports-radio host who interviews Nemesis on his own show ahead of Gyeah's April Anarchy card, in a roleplay posted on 27 October 1999.
